responsibility: Defines `rustc_middle`’s shared lint-level model and lint-emission support. It records how lint levels are sourced from defaults, attributes, and command-line options; stores per-HIR-node lint specifications and expectations; computes the effective user-visible lint level by combining local settings with `warnings`, caps, and driver overrides; and provides common logic for emitting lint diagnostics and for classifying spans originating from macro expansions or async/await desugarings.
